items.title: Introducing MongoDB Agents: Open Source Agent Templates for Atlas Agent Engine
items.summary: Teams increasingly want agents that handle routine database work: checking cluster alerts, reviewing slow queries, and answering questions about a schema. But building agents takes much more than a prompt. It requires credential handling, access scoping, tool orchestration, approval flows, a chat integration, evaluation, observability, and ongoing testing and maintenance. That plumbing is easy to underestimate, and it's where much of the effort goes.
